package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
)

// Rotate clears the gateway's key and returns a new enrollment token.
func Rotate(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	ports RotatePorts,
	in models.GatewayRef,
) (models.CreatedGateway, error) {
	return ports.Registry.Rotate(ctx, e, in)
}
